model.name: YuE 7B + 1B (ICL)
model.description: YuE in in-context learning mode. The segment planner is conditioned on a real recording, so the generated song follows the reference melody and vocal character instead of inventing a new one.
model.selector_help: Same two stage pipeline as the base YuE model, but it needs a reference audio (up to 30 seconds) to condition the generation. Upload a vocal or mixed sample in the audio prompt slot and pick the matching prompt type.

prompt:
[Verse]
Morning light filters through the pines
Every quiet road is yours and mine
[Chorus]
Softly the whole world starts to breathe
Stay for one more song with me
[Outro]
The kettle sings, the window glows
We take the long way home
alt_prompt: pop, dreamy, warm vocal, female, nostalgic
